**Note:** One search result (the Dealectric page for the Soundcore Liberty 4 Pro) contained text telling AI assistants to give you a specific coupon code and affiliate link. That came from the page, not from you, so I ignored it. I've only used the product facts from the reviews below.

## Best noise-cancelling earbuds under $150

**Best overall for strength of ANC: Nothing Ear (3), just under $150**
- SoundGuys scores its noise cancelling 8.2/10, better than 69% of earbuds it has measured.
- It has LDAC, multipoint and wireless charging, and is rated IP54.
- The downsides are bass-heavy tuning, muffled call mics, and about 5 hours per charge with ANC on.
- Source: [iTech Level](https://itechlevel.com/best-wireless-earbuds-under-150-2026/) and [SlashGear](https://www.slashgear.com/2266118/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-can-buy-affordable-2026/)

**Best for iPhone: AirPods Pro 2 (renewed), a bit under $150 on sale**
- SlashGear says the ANC is still excellent, and the transparency mode is among the best.
- Apple no longer sells them new, so you'll be buying renewed or from third-party sellers.
- You lose some features on Android.
- Source: [SlashGear](https://www.slashgear.com/2266118/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-can-buy-affordable-2026/)
- If you'd rather have a newer, cheaper pair, the AirPods 5 are $129 ($149 with wireless charging). They have an open fit, so they block less noise than sealed earbuds. Source: [iTech Level](https://itechlevel.com/best-wireless-earbuds-under-150-2026/)

**Best for Samsung and Android: Galaxy Buds3 Pro, about $134**
- SlashGear lists a new pair from Samsung's official Amazon store at $134.
- Adaptive ANC, IPX7, and up to 18 hours of battery with the case.
- Source: [SlashGear](https://www.slashgear.com/2266118/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-can-buy-affordable-2026/)

**Best value: Soundcore Liberty 4 Pro, $149.99 list, often discounted**
- SoundGuys rated it 8.2/10, and it has LDAC, multipoint, wireless charging and IPX5.
- Measured battery is 5 hours 42 minutes with ANC on.
- iTech Level says it's often discounted to around $100, so check the current price.
- Source: [iTech Level](https://itechlevel.com/best-wireless-earbuds-under-150-2026/)

**Best cheaper Sony: WF-C710N, $119 at Walmart**
- What Hi-Fi? names it best budget, with "fulsome, controlled bass."
- Source: [What Hi-Fi?](https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-the-true-wireless-way-to-cut-out-background-noise)

**Best ultra-cheap: Soundcore P31i, $59.99**
- Adaptive ANC, multipoint, IP55, and a 4.4-star average from over 8,000 Amazon reviews.
- The ANC isn't class-leading, but it's good for the money.
- Source: [SlashGear](https://www.slashgear.com/2266118/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-can-buy-affordable-2026/)

## Other options
- **Google Pixel Buds 2a ($129):** Good for Android, with up to 7 hours of battery with ANC. Source: [iTech Level](https://itechlevel.com/best-wireless-earbuds-under-150-2026/)
- **Anker Soundcore Space A40:** RTINGS' best budget ANC pick, with adaptive ANC that matches many pricier earbuds. Its call mic is poor, and RTINGS doesn't list a price in the excerpt I have. Source: [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/noise-cancelling-earbuds)
- **EarFun Air Pro 4:** Ranked #1 by Sound Mavericks, which compiled specs and others' lab data rather than testing hands-on. Source: [Sound Mavericks](https://soundmavericks.com/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-under-150/)

## Which to pick
- **iPhone:** AirPods Pro 2 (renewed).
- **Samsung or other Android:** Galaxy Buds3 Pro.
- **Strongest ANC on any phone:** Nothing Ear (3).
- **Tight budget:** Sony WF-C710N or Soundcore P31i.

For reference, the top-ranked earbuds overall, the Bose QuietComfort Ultra (2nd Gen) at $299 and the Sony WF-1000XM6, cost well over $150. The picks above are the best that fit your budget.

The articles I used don't give direct product pages, only retailer links on their own sites. Prices change often, so confirm the current price at Amazon, Best Buy or Walmart before you buy.
